home.heroSub: One API key for many models: chat, image, video, music and voice. Self-hosted, auditable, OpenAI-compatible.

features.title: OpenAI Compatible
features.desc: Standard /v1/chat/completions with SSE streaming; your existing SDKs just work.

features.title: Channel Failover
features.desc: Route one model across multiple upstream channels by priority.

features.title: Ledger Billing
features.desc: Balance holds and settlements with auditable usage entries.

features.title: Self-Hosted
features.desc: One docker compose for dependencies, single binary for the server.
